description: Check a user and role export for conflicting duties, access left on a closed account, and roles no rule covers. Choose this at an access review, or before an audit, when you need the conflicting grants named per user and the coverage gap of your own rule set. Do not choose this to design a permission model, to test an authentication flow, or to read roles directly from a directory service. Example requests: Check this user and role export for conflicting duties before the auditor sees it. | Which users can both create a supplier and release its payment? | Find access control conflicts and roles my rules do not cover.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

rules.description: The customer's rules.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text, one rule per line: CONFLICT=role_a|role_b, PRIVILEGED=role, MAX_ROLES=number. The conflicting role pairs and the privileged roles to look for. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

users.description: The customer's users.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row and the columns user, role, status. One row per user and role grant. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_access_conflict_check
title: Access conflict check
